summary.en: Baidu's AI model with strong Chinese understanding and search integration.
summary.zh: 百度的 AI 模型，具备强大的中文理解和搜索集成能力。

title.en: Baidu ERNIE API Key - Chinese AI with Search Integration | Get Model Key
title.zh: 百度文心 API Key - 集成搜索的中文 AI | Get Model Key

description.en: Get Baidu ERNIE API key for Chinese AI models. Access ERNIE series with Baidu search integration.
description.zh: 获取百度文心 API Key，访问中文 AI 模型。使用文心系列，集成百度搜索能力。

en: Baidu ERNIE (Wenxin) focuses on Chinese language understanding, with model tiers from reasoning-oriented ERNIE 5.0 Thinking down to Speed and Lite variants.
It is a common choice for China-region products that want Baidu Cloud integration and search-related strengths in Chinese NLP.
ERNIE APIs are issued through Baidu AI Cloud’s official console, not an aggregator. Get Model Key only links there and does not sell keys.
zh: 百度文心（ERNIE）侧重中文理解，覆盖从偏推理的文心 5.0 Thinking 到 Speed、Lite 等不同档位。
适合需要接入百度智能云、并希望在中文 NLP 场景发挥搜索相关优势的国内产品。
文心 API 由百度智能云官方控制台签发，并非聚合平台。Get Model Key 仅提供官方入口，不售卖密钥。

en: Log in to Baidu AI Cloud and open the ERNIE product overview in the console.
From console.bce.baidu.com AI → ERNIE, complete application/activation for the models you need.
Create application credentials (API Key / Secret Key) as shown in the Baidu console for your ERNIE app.
Call ERNIE endpoints with those credentials following cloud.baidu.com ERNIE documentation.
zh: 登录百度智能云，打开控制台中的文心（ERNIE）产品概览。
在 console.bce.baidu.com 的 AI → 文心 路径下，完成所需模型的开通/申请。
按控制台指引为文心应用创建 API Key / Secret Key 等凭证。
依照百度云文心文档，用上述凭证调用接口。

question.en: Is Wenxin the same as ERNIE for API access?
question.zh: 文心和大模型 API 里的 ERNIE 是一回事吗？

answer.en: Yes—Wenxin is the Chinese product name; API docs commonly use ERNIE. Use the Baidu AI Cloud console for keys.
answer.zh: 是。文心是产品中文名，接口文档常写作 ERNIE。密钥请在百度智能云控制台申请。

question.en: Where is the official Baidu ERNIE entry?
question.zh: 百度文心官方入口在哪里？

answer.en: Start at the ERNIE overview in Baidu AI Cloud: console.bce.baidu.com under AI → ERNIE. Docs are on cloud.baidu.com.
answer.zh: 从百度智能云 AI → 文心概览页进入（console.bce.baidu.com）。文档见 cloud.baidu.com。

question.en: Does Get Model Key sell Baidu API keys?
question.zh: Get Model Key 会售卖百度 API Key 吗？

answer.en: No. We only link to Baidu’s official console. Key creation and billing remain on Baidu Cloud.
answer.zh: 不会。本站只链接百度官方控制台，创建密钥与计费都在百度智能云完成。
